schemas.role: Define common structural types, including realized_closure_trace, T_sig, and classification classes.

ingest.role: Load raw closure traces from files or data structures.

sanitize.role: Clean and filter inputs, stripping forbidden fields (e.g. C_orient, -(i)).

feature_extract.role: Compute topological projections (loop count, crossing count, braid index proxies).

classify.role: Assign classes T0-Tx based strictly on T_sig.

audit.role: Emit verification-friendly decision traces and implementation verification output.
